fees.notes: Official Binary Business School international fee table (archived 25 Jan 2025: https://web.archive.org/web/20250125181117id_/https://binary.edu.my/bbs/): RM19,500 per year x 3 years = RM58,500 tuition. Additional official charges: registration RM600/year, library RM200/year, international admin RM1,960, visa processing RM2,980, refundable personal bond RM750-1,550. Binary's site states (Dec 2025) bachelor degrees are no longer offered on its own campus; table is the last published international fee.
